action.sql: SELECT (SUM(CASE WHEN a.type='Revenue' THEN g.credit-g.debit ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(g.account_id AS VARCHAR)='5000' THEN g.debit-g.credit ELSE 0 END)) * 100.0 / SUM(CASE WHEN a.type='Revenue' THEN g.credit-g.debit ELSE 0 END) AS gross_margin_pct FROM gl_lines g JOIN accounts a ON a.account_id=g.account_id WHERE g.entity_id='CA01' AND g.period BETWEEN '2026-01' AND '2026-03'
